what: Questions for Dustin about his own ranked turns: for each, his move and the other line asked about, with the position as reconstructed from his game review at the start of that turn. His answers are recorded in his own words.
answer_options: The alternative was better (my play was a mistake)

mapping_for_the_record.The alternative was better (my play was: The alternative becomes the key (key_line); recorded_move_acceptable is false; his recorded move becomes a rejected alternative with his words (rejected_because) and certified_by 'dustin'. This is v1.6's precedent (LAD-20261016_031512000_iOS-t2, 'Not attacking was a mistake').
mapping_for_the_record.Both were fine: The alternative is accepted (acceptable), with his words and certified_by 'dustin'; his recorded move stays the key.
mapping_for_the_record.My play was better: The alternative becomes a rejected alternative with his words (rejected_because) and certified_by 'dustin', and never counts; his recorded move stays the key. This is v1.6's precedent (e.g. LAD-20261014_161324000_iOS-t5).
mapping_for_the_record.Not sure: The alternative is left out: it is not accepted and never counts (it is recorded with his answer); his recorded move stays the key.
mapping_for_the_record.his note: His optional note (his thinking in the moment) is stored verbatim with the point (dustin_answer.words), whatever option he picks.
mapping_for_the_record.a shared question: One answer applies to each point the question covers (also_applies_to), each to its own pending line.
mapping_for_the_record.no answer: A question not answered by the freeze leaves its point pending and unscored (PREREG_RUN3 addendum 5, G10).
